## Instructions

1. Scald and peel the tomatoes; chop.
2. Put everything in a large kettle with vinegar, sugar and salt.
3. Add spices tied in cheesecloth.
4. Simmer 2 hours 30 minutes until thick, stirring often.
5. Pour into hot sterilized jars. [+]
